item.title: Hulk Hogan, Wrestling Icon and Self-Proclaimed 'Almost Metallica Bassist', Dies at 71
item.description: Hulk Hogan, one of the most famous names in professional wrestling and an unexpected figure in heavy metal lore, has died at the age of 71. The wrestling legend, born Terry Gene Bollea, passed away Thursday morning after suffering cardiac arrest at his home in Clearwater, Florida.
